customManagers.description: The Alpine image the installer checks run in, pinned by tag and digest inside the workflows' matrix values (a JSON string in ci.yml, a matrix container in release.yml).

packageRules.description: slicc-browsers ships one release to npm and as a Go module, and the guard harness requires both pins to name the same release: move @ai-ecoverse/slicc-browsers and github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-browsers in one PR, majors included.
